description: This file implements a command-line interface (CLI) tool for managing and visualizing an 'EasyMesh' network configuration using Bubble Tea framework. It includes functions to execute network commands, navigate and modify network nodes represented as trees, handle user input for editing configurations, and perform network testing procedures. It heavily interacts with C libraries via cgo for handling network topology data structures and execution of commands.

classes.name: item
classes.description: Represents a list item with a title and active state, with methods to render title with appropriate styles.

classes.name: EasyMeshCmd
classes.description: Struct holding command details for EasyMesh operations.

classes.name: MeshViews
classes.description: Main struct managing the mesh view UI, including network topology, command execution, and user interactions.

classes.name: DebugTest
classes.description: Struct used for managing debug/test configurations and statuses.

methods.name: CreateEasyMeshCommands
methods.description: Returns a map of command names to their respective EasyMeshCmd configurations.

methods.name: newMeshViews
methods.description: Initializes a new MeshViews instance with UI components and network topology tree.

methods.name: MeshViews.Init
methods.description: Initializes the UI state and fetches the initial network topology.

methods.name: MeshViews.nodestraverse_to_getdevconfig
methods.description: Traverses network nodes to gather device configurations, updating debug_test metrics.

methods.name: MeshViews.nodetraverse_to_enable_test
methods.description: Enables tests on network nodes, modifying node data accordingly.

methods.name: MeshViews.nodetraverse_to_update_dev_testconfigs
methods.description: Updates device test configurations in network nodes based on debug_test data.

methods.name: MeshViews.nodetraverse_to_update_ssidconfigs
methods.description: Traverses nodes to update SSID configurations with current test parameters.

methods.name: MeshViews.dev_test_handler
methods.description: Handles the execution and logic flow of device tests, invoking C functions and updating node data.

methods.name: MeshViews.treeToNodes
methods.description: Converts a UI tree node into a C network node structure for command execution.

methods.name: MeshViews.nodesToTree
methods.description: Converts C network node structures into UI tree nodes for display.

methods.name: MeshViews.getEMCommand
methods.description: Retrieves the EasyMeshCmd associated with a command string.

methods.name: MeshViews.execSelectedCommand
methods.description: Executes the selected command based on user input, handling GET, GETX, and SET operations.

methods.name: MeshViews.Update
methods.description: Handles user input and updates the UI and network topology state accordingly.

methods.name: MeshViews.View
methods.description: Renders the entire CLI view, including menu, network topology, and control buttons.
